definitions.explanation: A person who performs music, especially someone who plays a musical instrument.

examples.japanese: {演奏者|えんそうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The performer went up on stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦オーケストラ→オーケストラ：04466_ookesutora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{演奏者|えんそうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This orchestra has a hundred performers.

examples.japanese: {演奏者|えんそうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}→表現力：21315_hyougenryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the performer's technique and expressiveness.

notes:
{演奏者|えんそうしゃ} is composed of ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧ (musical performance) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). It refers to anyone who performs music, especially instrumentalists.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{演奏者|えんそうしゃ}: piano player
- {演奏者|えんそうしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: be active as a performer
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{演奏者|えんそうしゃ}: professional musician
- {演奏者|えんそうしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聴衆|ちょうしゅう}→聴衆：13907_choushuu⟧: performers and audience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ミュージシャン: musician — the English loanword, used more broadly and casually
- ⟦{奏者|そうしゃ}→奏者：06964_sousha⟧: player — shorter form, often used in compounds like {独奏者|どくそうしゃ} (soloist)
- ⟦{音楽家|おんがくか}→音楽家：27511_ongakuka⟧: musician — emphasizes music as a profession or calling; includes composers
- ⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧: singer — specifically a vocalist, not an instrumentalist
